correctness.rationale: The exact semigroup-ring block-product coefficient \(r_X(i)c_Y(j)\) yields necessary and sufficient row/column-signature constancy. Two-row signatures split into separated and balanced cases. In balanced cases, each class label has a unique partner because equal column signatures encode unordered column label pairs; row-balancedness forces even, equally oriented paired columns. The converse constructions satisfy closure; generators in S_2 x S_n have exactly the stated orbits. Weighted set partitions count disjoint unique choices. An independent direct-product closure enumerator exhausts every partition through ten cells and verifies both enumeration and constructed automorphism orbits (totals 2,5,13,48,184). The proof establishes all n; finite tests are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The primary paper explicitly notes rectangular-band Schur rings not captured by product partitions, and counts only small cases. Classifying all Schur partitions for an infinite and natural noncancellative semigroup family, proving they are all automorphic, and deriving exact weighted-Bell enumeration (including 48 and 184 in the first previously unlisted widths) supplies a motivated structural and enumerative result, not a renamed general Schur-ring theorem or arbitrary numerical slice.
